title: trust(): the checked door
goal: Blocking everything would make the language useless. This is how checked data gets through.
notes: The model suggests a file name. The program checks it in plain code, then calls trust(value, reason). Only then may it become part of a path.
Change the reply in model.json to "../../etc/passwd" or "x.sh": the check refuses it.
Delete the check and keep trust(): now the mistake is yours, and the journal shows who vouched for what. The allow list still holds: nothing is written outside ./notes.
